name: Zeus: Master of Olympus city-builder recreation

mentions.name: Zeus: Master of Olympus city-builder recreation
mentions.description: This project recreates the city building portion of the classic Sierra game Zeus: Master of Olympus, beginning with reverse engineering the original game's asset files. The long-term goal is to learn enough to build an original city-building game based on Celtic and Norse history.
mentions.source_excerpt: I started the year by setting out to recreate the city building portion of an old sierra game (Zeus, master of Olympus) the first few days have been mostly reverse engineering the asset files from the original game.
